title: An ad-free Android TV
summary: This article presents a solution for achieving an ad-free experience on Android TV devices, likely using network-level ad blocking techniques such as custom DNS or modified hosts files to filter out advertisements across all apps and services on the TV.
problem_solved: Eliminates intrusive advertisements and trackers on Android TV devices for a cleaner viewing experience.
why_valuable: It provides a free, open-source method to remove ads system-wide on Android TV, improving user experience and privacy without requiring expensive hardware or subscriptions.
